notes.title: v4.0 UPDATE for FotoMuseo 3D
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=epAtTktPH-4;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, the [b]NEW Contents[/b]for [b][i]FotoMuseo 3D are released.[/i] [/b] with the [b]UPDATE[/b] of the [b]Version 4.0 [/b]of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267960/

Hard work that have been  rewarded my patience and tenacity in many moments. Here the [b][i][url=http://www.variedalia.com/2024/04/FM3D-MaIAExpo2NovedadesV4.html]COMPLETE CHANGELOG[/url][/i][/b] of changes for this [b][i]v4.0 UPDATE[/i][/b]:

[u][i][b][u]EXPO 1 - 365 NOSTALGIC ITEMS[/u][/b][/i][/u]
[list][*][b]Own Achievement System [/b]implemented to see the achievements that we achieved during the [b][i]gameplay [/i][/b]and that we will achieve in [b][i]Steam.[/i][/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Take[/b] the [b]Flashlight [/b]and the[b] Glasses[i] ProxVisor[/i] [/b]from being [b]optional [/b]they become[b] mandatory [/b]to advance the adventure.[/*][*]Added [b]Icon [/b]from [b]HUD [/b]that tells us when we are [b]crouching.[/b][/*][*]Added [b]Message [/b]from [b]HUD [/b]to tell us [b][i]"Wait"[/i][/b] when a dialogue is playing and we try to perform some action.
[/*][*]Added the [b]Dialogues [/b]of our character for the entire [b]Expo 1. [/b]
[/*][*]Added the option to choose between [b]4 Wishes[/b] to the [b]Dragon [i]Rhexon,[/i] [/b]during the [b]level [i]Secret of the Dragon Sky.[/i][/b][/*][list][*]Added [b]4 pedestals[/b] to choose [b]our wish [/b]before asking the [b]Dragon.[/b][/*][/list][*]The new [b]Secret Maps [/b]unlockable after making our wish include:[b][/b][/*][list][*][b]Level: [/b][i][b]"Grateful Maze."[/b][/i][/*][*][b]Level:[/b] [i][b] "Gravity Tool."[/b][/i][/*][*][b]Level:[/b][i][b] "Reflections and Farewells."[/b][/i][/*][*][b]Level:[/b][i][b] "Koddy Rider"[/b][/i][/*][/list][*]Modified the route of the[b] level [i]"Dragon Sky":[/i][/b][/*][list][*] Now to access the upper part we must use a [b]cloud flying [/b]type [i][b]Kinton,[/b][/i] instead of going up on foot as we did before.[/*][/list][*][b][i] Rhexon [/i][/b]appears and disappears now with a [b]Lightning+Thunder [/b]before and after making our [b]wish.[/b][/*][*][b] Added the obligation [/b]to do the [b]Leap of Faith [/b]as in the [i][b]Assassins Creed [/b][/i]from the platform indicated by the [b] Eagle [/b]summoned by [b]Rhexon. [/b]If we make the [b]jump[/b]from any [b]other place [/b]in Heaven, the [b]Desire [/b]chosen [b]will not be fulfilled.[/b] [/*][/list][list][*]When we make a [b]wish [/b]to the [b]Dragon, [/b]access to the chosen secret map will be unlocked.[/*][/list][list][*]Something will change or be unlocked in the following levels giving us access to the [b]Secret Level [/b]selected in the [b]Wish.[/b][/*][*]For example , access to the [b]Secret Level [/b]of [i][b]Koddy Ridder, [/b][/i]we will do it from the secret area of [b][i]Koddy [/i][/b]inside [b][i]FotoMuseo. [/i][/b]But we will only be able to access it once we make the wish.[/*][/list][list][*]If [b]we die[/b]at some level for whatever reason, [b]the Wish[/b]requested to [b][i]Rhexon[/i][/b]and that would unlock some of the secret maps[b] will be cancelled[/b] as well.[/*][/list][list][*]Added a [b][i]Koddy [/i][/b]Interactive and drivable.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Interactive water [/b]in one of the [b]taps [/b]in the [b]bathroom [/b]of [b]PhotoMuseo.[/b][/*][*]Added [b][i]SHADER [/i][/b]of [b]dynamic clouds [/b]for the sky.[/*][*]Added movement to all [b]VEGETATION [i](trees, bushes, plants...) [/i][/b] decorative of the game. Both at the level of [i][b]TERRAIN/SKYBOX [/b][/i]and at the level of [b]independent 3D models [/b].[/*][*]Corrected bug in [b][i]SHADER [/i][/b]of [b]shadows [/b]that did not reflect the [b]shadow of the leaves [/b]of the trees. Now they are seen correctly.[/*][*]Once the previous bug has been corrected, it has also been possible to [b]animate the shadow[/b]showing how the leaves move through the air in the shadow as well.[/*][*]Created [b]Camera System [/b]that allows the game to momentarily deactivate the [b]First Person camera [/b]of our character to show us [b]areas of interest [/b] or [b]important events[/b] in the [b]game.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]Created [b]Rudimentary [/b]Reflex System of Mirrors [/b]through [b]cameras.[/b][/*][list][*]Inserted in some of the levels of [b]Expo 1.[/b][/*][/list][/list][list][*]Created rudimentary [b]Inventory System[/b]. If we have an object that requires both hands, we will not be able to interact with the environment until we release it or fulfill its objective.[/*][*]Created [b]Rudimentary [/b]Code System. Now we can change the [b]Language [/b]during the game, as well as directly access the different [b]Levels/Maps.[/b][/*][*][b]Bug Corrections [/b]and [b]Optimization [/b]of various [b]levels.[/b][/*][/list] [u][i][b][u]EXPO 2 -365 "MAIA - BOUDOIR PORTRAIT"[/u][/b][/i][/u][list][*]Replaced from the [b]Graphic material[/b]exposed in the [b]3D Model[/b]of the building that I modeled of the [b][i]ATPD: "Association of Dental Prosthetic Technicians of the Basque Country",[/i][/b] for the photos of the new [b]Ambassador[/b] from [b]Expo 2,[/b] [url=http://www.variedalia.com/search/label/MaIA][b][i]MaIA[/i][/b][/url] for the [b][i][url=http://www.variedalia.com/search/label/MaIA]Boudoir Portrait Project[/url].[/i][/b][/*][/list][list][*]Modeled a [b]hybrid train unit [/b]based on those of [b][i]Metro Bilbao [/i][/b]and [b][i]Euskotren. [/i][/b][/*][list][*]Inserted in the [b]Start level [/b]of [b]Expo 2. [/b]As an option to go to [b]PhotoMuseo.[/b][/*][/list][/list][list][*]Modified the [b]route of the original Train [/b]type [b]Ave [/b], so that do not collide with the [b]hybrid unit[/b]at the [b]Station.[/b][/*][*]Prepared a [b]LEGO Building System[/b] to add [b]models 3D [/b]of [b][i]Lego [/i][/b]created in [b][i]Leocad.[/i][/b][/*][/list][list] [*]Prepared system to introduce [b]3D models[/b] your own created with the [b][i]Townscaper.[/i][/b][/*][/list]That's nothing! I am tremendously proud of all the [b]work[/b]carried out in [b]1 and a half / 2 years[/b] of work. I invite you to visit [b][i]FotoMuseo 3D [/i][/b]during its [b]4th Anniversary [/b]

[h3][b][i]Will you dare to cross the portal and discover the secrets of FotoMuseo 3D?[/i][/b]

notes.title: Version 4.0 of FotoMuseo 3D will be released during the 4th Anniversary on Steam
notes.notes:
[i][b]FotoMuseo 3D[/b][/i]is going to turn [b]4 years old.[/b] And to celebrate it, i will present [b]4.0 Version[/b] of the game during the anniversary. With lots of new content for [b]Expo 1,[/b] as well as abundant improvements.

But it also introduces a [b]new feature,[/b] for [b]Expo 2[/b] [i][b](which is still in development).[/b][/i] This will bring with it a new ambassador who has earned merits for becoming the central theme of the Photographs that will be exhibited during our exploration adventures along all the levels of [i][b]Expo 2.[/b][/i]

[url=http://www.variedalia.com/2024/04/FM3D-MaIAExpo2NovedadesV4.html][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/37403819/32ab300ca7991b83d1a85beb5f9926fd74ad8cb2.jpg[/img][/url]
The game will continue increasing in contents little by little over time, releasing future new Versions. Always improving [b]new secret levels[/b]to develop for [b]EXPO 1.[/b] And of course, the developing of the levels presented in [b]EXPO 2.[/b]

I'm still [u][b]only developer[/b][/u] dividing my time between my [b]family, work, photography[/b] and [b]FotoMuseo 3D...[/b] So I'm very proud of what i have achieved so far with this project.

If everything goes as planned,[i][b] FotoMuseo 3D v4.0[/b][/i] will be released on [b]May 18, 2024.[/b] You have the link to the blog with the list of changes in the cover image above.

notes.title: 1st Anniversary - Premiere of Version 3.0 of FotoMuseo 3D
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ebWOE1Qz8tk;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the[i][b] 1st Anniversary of FotoMuseo 3D[/b][/i], a major in-game content update has been prepared. In addition to a new presentation:

[previewyoutube=pfcz7bavLp4;full][/previewyoutube]

The content added in this [i][b]Version 3.0[/b][/i] of the game contains the following:
[list]
[*]Creation of a totally new zone in the Language Selection Level.
[*]Personalized "thank you" screen for people who support the game.
[*]New Achievements.
[*]New Zone with new building on the Tutorials level. Now we must get the Proxvisor Glasses in this house before heading to the Earthgate.
[*]New room inside the Ship corresponding to the COMMAND BRIDGE to UNLOCK access to the HANGARS.
[*]Optimized the Tutorial Level and bug fixes.
[*]Enlargement of the area prior to the FotoMuseo with the secret game of painting a canvas and accessing its hidden area.
[*]The Holograms of this previous area have been improved and mechanical models have been added simulating the movement of the animals.
[*]New secret areas within FotoMuseo.
[*]Photo room security cameras now focus and track the player.
[*]We have access to the cameras from the Main Hall of the FotoMuseo (where we buy the tickets).
[*]Correction of errors in the last levels of EXPO 1.
[*]Added 3 LEVELS of EXPO 2 in ALPHA phase.
[*]Map 1 of EXPO 2 will be a small open world. For now without buildings that will be created little by little.
[*]Map 2 of EXPO 2 will be a cave map where a great secret is hidden in a box that will soon reveal its nature.
[*]Map 3 of EXPO 2 will be the arrival by Train through a very special Earthgate.
[*]These 3 maps from EXPO 2 are a PRELIMINARY and PROVISIONAL version of what they will be at the end. The work is still in progress so it will undergo many changes and content improvements over time.
[/list]

And broadly speaking, these are all the additions of[i][b] version 3.0 of FotoMuseo 3D.[/b][/i]

[i][b]Will you dare to cross the Earthgate to discover all the secrets of FotoMuseo 3D?[/b][/i]
